title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA’S GREETINGS ON THE EVE OF ONAM
body_text:
The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu in her message on the eve of Onam says: -
“On the auspicious occasion of Onam, I extend my warm greetings and best wishes to all citizens, especially the brothers and sisters of Keralam living in India and abroad.
This festival is an occasion to express gratitude to nature on arrival of the new harvest. Onam celebrates our rich culture and spirit of brotherhood. It promotes unity in diversity. Boat races, folk dances, music and sports are important traditions associated with this festival. They showcase the culture and values of Keralam.
I pray that this auspicious festival brings happiness, peace, good health and prosperity to all, and inspire the citizens to contribute to the nation’s progress”.
****
MJPS/SS/PRK

enrichment.summary: The President of India, Droupadi Murmu, issued a message extending greetings to citizens, especially Keralites in India and abroad, on the eve of Onam. She described Onam as a harvest festival celebrating gratitude to nature, cultural richness, and unity in diversity, highlighting traditions like boat races, folk dances, music and sports. She prayed for happiness, peace, health and prosperity for all.
enrichment.context: This is a routine ceremonial greeting issued by the President's Secretariat on the occasion of Onam, a major harvest festival celebrated predominantly in Kerala. Such greetings are issued for all major festivals by the President, Vice President and Prime Minister as part of customary practice, without any policy content. They serve symbolic and diplomatic purposes of promoting social harmony and national unity but carry no administrative or legislative significance.

related_articles.relationship: Both are part of the same recurring series of presidential greetings issued on the eve of major festivals, following the same format of extending wishes to the community and citizens.
